assessor: RTS implementation preflight — Bounded Probe Executor v1
rationale: Bounded repository-local campaign compiler/executor over callable adapters only. v1 has no provider implementation, no credentials, no network calls, and no runtime router mutation. All execution is fingerprint-bound to explicit approval, resource ceilings are validated before work, checkpoints are resumable, and profile application only materializes a reviewable local artifact.
existing_assumptions: F probe plans are advisory and execution=NOT_PERFORMED.
Provider-specific adapter code is a separate future credential/runtime boundary.
Observed engine identity is metadata, not an internal architecture claim.

data_migration.notes: No existing profile, memory, FREEZER history, or runtime router is mutated.

approval_changes: campaign execution requires exact fingerprint human approval
profile application remains LOCAL_POLICY_ARTIFACT_ONLY and never runtime authority
hidden_dependencies: worst-case retry attempts and estimated cost must be included before campaign authorization
adapter observation must exactly match campaign engine/domain/task/variant
resume must treat completed/quarantined jobs as terminal
rollback_boundary: Drop the G branch or revert the bounded_probe_executor files and FRZ-000017 append-only versions; A-F remain untouched.
completion_conditions: queue overflow fails closed instead of truncating
unapproved campaigns cannot invoke an adapter
worst-case retries fit both attempts and cost ceilings
chunked execution resumes without duplicate completed work
adapter output cannot persist hidden/raw text
only same-engine STABLE profiles can reach review-required application preview
human-approved application produces local rollback-capable artifact without runtime mutation
A-G regressions and FREEZER verify pass
risks: callable adapters can still perform external work outside this package; authorization boundary must be enforced before invocation
thread cancellation cannot forcibly terminate arbitrary adapter code; adapter timeout is part of the adapter contract
estimated cost is only as accurate as task estimates and therefore the worst-case budget is a ceiling, not billing evidence
